newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Scania shares tumble 3 pct on 9 month fall.
newsitem.headline: Scania shares tumble 3 pct on 9 month fall.

text.p: Swedish truck and bus maker Scania fell three percent on the Stockholm bourse after posting a 39 percent fall in profit after financial items for the first nine months of 1996 which was below market expectations.
By 1155 GMT Scania was 5.5 crowns lower at 170.5 crowns. Before the result was released Scania's share price was 174.5.
A Reuter poll of 11 analysts found an average forecast for a profit after financial items of 2.65 billion crowns.
The company posted a profit after financial items of 2.14 billion crowns.
